answer: Draw every five-seat review panel from distinct autonomous systems and intake epochs: each juror locks a 6,000 POA bond in the meadow registry and signs a route claim with its lantern key during a 10-minute dawn sortition window (2.8% of the epoch). Peer verifiers check each BGP prefix proof in 2 ms and slash 85% of the bond if two seats trace to the same provider subnet. An honest solo juror locks 6,000 POA once and pays a 5 POA audit fee, whereas 300 Sybils on one cloud host can fill at most one seat per panel despite locking 1,800,000 POA. This fails if prefixes are leased.
